_provenance: Copied from UI_v2:code/Model2_Performance/ridge_model.pkl + scaler.pkl (train.py @ commit 811254b3 'updated model'), retrained under scikit-learn 1.8.0 to match this repo's pinned version. Superseded the previous bundled Ridge model (performance_model.pkl, 53 features) from the preprocessor branch. See ../docs/ML_MODELS_OVERVIEW.md for the full writeup.

formula_score.raw_inputs_all_live: technical_competence_score, domain_knowledge_score, problem_solving_score, communication_score, leadership_score, initiative_score, time_management_score, quality_of_work_score, and productivity_score are sourced from the live performance_reviews table. collaboration_score is sourced from the live employees table, NOT performance_reviews — both tables have a same-named column, and UI_v2's pre_processing.py (commit 811254b3) explicitly keeps the employees.csv one (the merge's collaboration_score_y, renamed) as what the model trains on. An earlier version of this model (superseded, not what's shipped here) had a preprocessing bug where this column resolved to neither and silently defaulted to 0 for every row.

imputation: Ridge has no built-in imputer. Any of the 9 performance_reviews-sourced raw formula_score inputs missing on an employee's latest review, or a missing employees.collaboration_score / historical_performance_score (11 raw inputs total), are filled with the training-set median before the formula is computed — see raw_medians below, sourced from UI_v2:code/Model2_Performance/processed_data.csv.

metrics.note: Re-measured by re-running train.py against UI_v2:code/Model2_Performance/processed_data.csv (commit 811254b3) under scikit-learn 1.8.0 (this branch's pinned version) — not persisted anywhere in the source repo originally.
